vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: domain-trust-check
Version: 1.2.3

The domain-trust-check skill is a legitimate tool for checking URL safety and domain reputation via the Outtake Trust API (outtake.ai). It uses standard curl commands to interact with documented API endpoints and requires a user-provided API key. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection; the code and instructions in SKILL.md and references/api.md are consistent with the stated purpose of scanning links for threats.
